changes.title: Swarms
items: Each area's wild swarm now grows along the runestone order, from a single young at the first stone to about 12 at the last, mostly young near home and mostly adults far out

Every kind of animal is equally dangerous: strong kinds (bears, boars, stags…) come as at most 6 tough ones, light kinds (hedgehogs, bats, beetles…) as up to 16 small ones, and the forest holds fewer wild animals than before
Soundsystems are much easier to knock down (500 health, from 4000): stop a swarm before it gets there

changes.title: Ring runestones
items: The dancefloor ring's runestones stand as tall as an area's runestone, carved and mossed the same, at half its width, before the boot turns each into its speaker

changes.title: No familiars
items: No more familiars: the cat, crow, toad and bat are gone from the character creator and from the other witches at the party, so the only animals are the forest's own (a saved witch with one simply loads without it)
